conviction_note: The numbers are new (no szacunkowe wyniki for Q3 was filed) and the release usually updates the eco-bomb revenue outlook, so abs_move is 6.5%. That sits on the stock's own results-day moves (+15.1% Q3'24, +3.5% Q3'25, +0.4% Q1'26, +8.0% Q2'26) and its $0.35m/day turnover. The sign is close to a coin: the company-guided Q3 eco-bomb revenue and the Q4 contract wins lean to a beat and a raised Q4 line, but the stock is near its 2021 record, Erste expects investors to sell a 'very good' quarter, and the 2027 eco-bomb backlog is thin. The bar is disputed (Erste EBITDA 47m vs Trigon 58m), so the findings stay small and p_up is 54. impact_sum +0.3 and the scaled +0.52 agree in sign and size.

findings.finding: The company estimated Q3 2026 eco-bomb (illegal-dump clean-up) revenue at 57.1m PLN, against 42.3m for all of H1, with 38.6m of the 87.3m Nowe Miszewo contract billed in Q3. These contracts lifted incineration and RDF prices by 22% and 44% y/y in H1, which points to Q3 EBITDA above Erste's 47m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 EBITDA beat the PAP consensus by 21% (44.4 vs 36.6) and the stock rose 7.96% on the day, then gave back 2.5%. Q3 2024's beat was followed by +15.1%. Q1 2026, roughly in line, moved +0.4%.
findings.original_quote: Ponad dwa miesiące temu spółka szacowała przychody z tego tytułu na 57,1 mln zł. Dla porównania w całej I połowie 2026 r. sięgnęły one 42,3 mln zł. [...] Kontrakt w Nowym Miszewie jest wart 87,3 mln zł, z czego 38,6 mln zł miało zostać rozliczone w III kwartale tego roku. (More than two months ago the company estimated revenue from this at 57.1m PLN, against 42.3m in all of H1 2026. [...] The Nowe Miszewo contract is worth 87.3m, of which 38.6m was to be settled in Q3.)
findings.why_not_priced: The revenue estimate itself is public and inside the company's own guide, which is why this is sized small. What is not settled is the EBITDA it converts to: the two published sell-side numbers differ by 11m PLN (47 vs 58), about 20% of the quarter. If the market had settled on the high end, the stock would already sit above Noble's 462 target rather than flat over 20 days (-1.74%).
findings.independence: Trigon's 58m EBITDA estimate (https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/art45327161-rekord-kursu-mo-bruku-coraz-blizej-analitycy-prognozuja-dobre-wyniki) and the H1 price-mix disclosure (https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20260827/zysk-netto-mo-bruku-w-ii-kw-26-wyniosl-265-mln-zl-powyzej-oczekiwan) point the same way

findings.finding: The Q4 2026 eco-bomb revenue estimate of 19.5m PLN is likely to be raised in the release. The CEO said those estimates are 'already history' after Q4 tender wins totalling 28m PLN in six municipalities, plus a 15.9m Głogów contract. Partly offsetting: the Koziegłowy contract finished at about 1k t of an estimated 3.5k t (max 22.5m net).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Mo-Bruk issues eco-bomb revenue estimates in its results releases. Q3 2025's release guided Q4'25 eco revenue above 30m and the stock rose 3.5% the next day despite a reported loss. Q2 2026's '57.1m in Q3' came with the +7.96% day.
findings.original_quote: Z kolei prognoza na IV kwartał mówiła jedynie o 19,5 mln zł wpływów. Te szacunki to już jednak historia. [...] w IV kwartale grupa wygrała samodzielnie bądź w konsorcjum przetargi ogłoszone przez gminy Olkusz, Pruszcz, Kędzierzyn-Koźle, Gierałtowice, Piekary Śląskie oraz przez miasto Gliwice. Łącznie opiewają one na 28 mln zł. [...] faktyczna ilość usuniętych i przetworzonych odpadów wyniosła około 1 tys. ton (The Q4 forecast spoke of only 19.5m PLN of revenue. Those estimates are already history. [...] in Q4 the group won tenders in Olkusz, Pruszcz, Kędzierzyn-Koźle, Gierałtowice, Piekary Śląskie and Gliwice, worth 28m PLN in total. [...] the actual amount of waste removed and processed was about 1,000 tonnes.)
findings.why_not_priced: The wins appeared only in a Parkiet interview (4 Nov). Contracts of 1-10m PLN each did not trigger an ESPI current report, so no number reached the wire. The stock fell 2.9% on 5 Nov and is flat since, which is not what a raised Q4 line already in the price would look like. Erste still models 2026 eco revenue at about 120m (=42.3+57.1+19.5), the old Q4 figure.
findings.independence: The Głogów contract (15.9m net, to Oct 2027) and the overall backlog figure of about 190m in Noble's note are cited at https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/art45327161-rekord-kursu-mo-bruku-coraz-blizej-analitycy-prognozuja-dobre-wyniki. Same publisher, different article.

findings.finding: Erste's analyst expects a 'very good' Q3 that investors may use to sell, because later quarters look weaker. From the current backlog he puts 2027 eco-bomb revenue at about 13m PLN against about 120m in 2026. He also puts Q3 utilisation at about 60% in solidification/stabilisation and 45% in RDF (weak Polish RDF demand), against full use in incineration.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed case of this stock reacting to a forward eco-bomb cliff. The 2021-2022 eco-bomb drop-off (46.4m in 9M21 to 17.6m in 9M22) came with a multi-year derating, but that is out-of-sample context and not a dated reaction.
findings.original_quote: Będą one bardzo dobre, co część inwestorów może uznać za dobrą okazję do sprzedaży posiadanych walorów, zwłaszcza że kolejne kwartały już tak dobrze się nie zapowiadają [...] O ile w całym tym roku wyniesie około 120 mln zł, o tyle na 2027 r. można go dziś szacować na zaledwie 13 mln zł (They will be very good, which some investors may see as a good chance to sell, especially as the following quarters do not look as good [...] While this year it will be about 120m PLN, for 2027 it can today be estimated at only 13m PLN.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the article is a month old and the stock has gone sideways since. What is unpriced is whether the release gives a 2027 eco-bomb view. If it confirms a thin 2027 with no Wołomin award (bids now due 27 Nov), the forward EBITDA path behind the 613m 2026-28 incentive target has to be rebuilt without eco-bombs. Sized small because the 28m of Q4 wins and the Wołomin option argue against it.
findings.independence: none. The 2027 backlog figure rests on Erste's arithmetic alone, and management argues the tender pipeline is growing because the municipal co-funding share was cut from 20% to 1% (https://www.parkiet.com/firmy/art45438001-likwidacja-bomb-ekologicznych-napedza-biznes-mo-bruku)

findings.finding: On 25 Sep Mo-Bruk signed a 45m PLN Alior investment loan, to Aug 2033, to refinance the Eco-Point acquisition, secured by a 90m registered pledge on Eco-Point's assets. A 20m overdraft with a zero balance was allowed to lapse.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: none observed; neither report (25 Sep, 26 Oct) moved the stock more than ordinary daily volatility
findings.original_quote: Przedmiotem Umowy jest udzielenie kredytu w kwocie 45.000.000,00 zł. Celem kredytu jest refinansowanie nabycia przez Kredytobiorcę udziałów w spółce ECO-POINT P.S.A. [...] saldo zadłużenia z tytułu Kredytu w Rachunku bieżącym wynosiło 0 zł. (The agreement provides a loan of 45.0m PLN. Its purpose is to refinance the Borrower's purchase of shares in ECO-POINT P.S.A. [...] the overdraft balance was 0 PLN.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The loan refinances an acquisition already paid for, with no distress signal: the overdraft was unused. Filed at 0 because the money buys term-out of the M&A cash, not a ramp or a rescue. The only thing it adds to the print is a little more net debt and interest in Q4.
findings.independence: The pledge report RB 28/2026 (https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/163948,mo-bruk-sa-28-2026-ustanowienie-zastawu-rejestrowego) confirms the same facility

baseline_tension: The finding sum (+0.3) and p_up (54) lean slightly positive. That is orthogonal to the lean, which is the 20-day run-up: flat (-1.74%), with no register. The +16.6% 60-day run-up and the near-record price argue the good quarter is at least partly in the price, which is why p_up stays close to 50.

lessons_applied: 'A number the market has already been told is worth 0': cut the Q3 eco-bomb finding from +0.8 to +0.4, because the revenue estimate is the company's own; what is left is the EBITDA conversion the bar disputes
'The move is in the guide': raised the Q4 eco-bomb guidance finding from +0.7 to +0.8
'Two findings resting on one document are one': merged the RDF/S&S utilisation item (-0.3) into the Erste 2027-cliff finding, which goes from -0.8 to -0.9

'Understatement / size the move on what is new': raised abs_move_pct from 6.0 to 6.5 on the stock's own results-day moves (median about 5.8%; 15.1% and 8.0% on beats), new numbers and a likely guide update; p_up unchanged at 54
